concerns.text: The plan describes computation of the three bulk‑lattice clustering descriptors (Phase 3) and dataset assembly (Phase 6) but does not mention the additional structural covariates required by the data model and `contracts/dataset.schema.yaml` (misorientation_angle, boundary_plane, local_lattice_strain, atomic_radius, electronegativity). This omission creates a mismatch between the plan and the data‑model/contract specifications.
